phrases.phrase: Enter your API key generated from the pay.mmocoin.pro merchant dashboard (starts with mmo_live_ or mmo_sk_).

Required. Must match the webhook secret set on this merchant's pay.mmocoin.pro account, with the webhook URL there pointed at this forum's payment_callback.php?_xfProvider=mmocoinpay. Payments cannot be approved without it.
Base URL for the MMOCoin Pay API (default: https://pay.mmocoin.pro).
Comma-separated list of tokens to accept (USDC, USDT, MMO). Ensure your payout wallet holds at least ~0.01 SOL for rent.
User Upgrades using this payment profile must be priced in USD. The dollar amount is converted into whichever token the buyer picks at checkout.
Could not start the checkout session. Please try again shortly.
This upgrade is not priced in USD, so MMOCoin Pay cannot convert it into a token amount. Ask the site owner to fix the upgrade's currency.
You must enter your MMOCoin Pay API key.
You must enter a webhook signing secret, and set the same one on your pay.mmocoin.pro account.
